messages:
alex: hey all :wave: I'm running streaming generate tests and I can't find a 'sandbox' API key in the console — I only see a 'hosted' key under Project Settings. Where should I pull the sandbox key from? Also what are the sandbox default quotas and streaming rate limits? I want to avoid hitting prod accidentally.
devx-bot: Hi Alex — sandbox creds are on the Team -> Sandbox credentials page (team-level, not project-level). If you don't see them your account might not have the sandbox role enabled. Quick defaults (current):
- sandbox token quota: 25,000 tokens/day
- request rate: 5 requests/sec per key
- streaming concurrency: 2 streams per key
- embeddings quota: 5,000 vectors/day
Hosted keys are tied to billing and reserved for production traffic — don't reuse them for experiments.
If you want to inspect remaining quota run:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY_SANDBOX" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/v1/usage/quota
```
and you'll see JSON with tokens_remaining and stream_concurrency.

If you actually used a hosted key by accident, rotate it immediately and file a billing alert.
tj (DevEx): Adding a couple of practical notes:
- For local tests set env var: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY_SANDBOX="sandbox-xxx"`
- Streaming endpoints count tokens as they are generated — long-running streams will chew quota quickly.
- Rate-limit errors come back as 429 with `x-rate-limit-reset` header; use exponential backoff for retries.

If you need a higher sandbox quota (or more streaming concurrency) please ping `@devx-ops` with the project name, team name, and expected tokens/day. Here's a template you can paste:

```
Hi devx-ops — request for sandbox quota increase
Org: redwood-examples
Team: sandbox-team-42
Project: demo-streaming
Current quota: 25k tokens/day
Requested quota: 100k tokens/day
Reason: perf testing streaming with 20 concurrent users
```

samir: I can file this on Alex's behalf if you want — cc'ing @devx-ops in 1:1.
alex: thanks @samir, that would be great. One more q: are there separate quotas per-team or per-key?
tj (DevEx): Per-key quotas apply (so multiple sandbox keys -> aggregated limits per-team). We prefer issuing a team-scoped sandbox key for test harnesses. For CI use the ephemeral CI tokens — ask security if you need them.
maria (Security): Note: never commit keys to public repos. Use the Secrets store or the CI vault integration. We'll help rotate any keys if you suspect leakage.
alex: awesome, thanks all :thumbsup: I'll wait for the quota bump and use the sandbox key once it's provisioned.
